scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build:production && node scripts/verify-deploy-config.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run
scripts.check: npm run cf-typegen && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && npm run build:staging && node scripts/verify-deploy-config.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build:production && node scripts/verify-deploy-config.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env production
